study_identification_part.si_4_title: Closing the life-cycle of normative modeling using federated hierarchical Bayesian regression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: 16 neuroimaging datasets used in multi-site normative modeling experiments. ABCD=10732 scans (ages 9-11), Cam-CAN=647 (ages 18-88), CMI/HBN=893 (ages 18-88), CNP=264 (ages 21-50, includes 49 SZ, 49 BD, 41 ADHD), FCON=1021 (ages 8-85, includes 25 ADHD), HCP=1113 (ages 22-37), HCP-A=677 (ages 36-100), HCP-D=653 (ages 8-22), HCP-EP=180 (ages 17-36, includes 123 EP), IXI=557 (ages 20-86), NKI=482 (ages 6-85), OASIS-3=2044 (ages 43-97, includes 271 DM, 51 MCI), OPN=612 (ages 8-58), PNC=1514 (ages 8-23), TOP=823 (ages 17-69, includes 167 SZ, 193 BD, 31 MDD, 107 others), UK Biobank=14914 (ages 44-80). Total=37126 scans from 79 scanners. OPN dataset listed in Table 1 is from OpenNeuro and not specifically categorized in the dataset list.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Four experiments conducted: 1) multi-site data regression (80% healthy train, 20% test across all datasets); 2) model extension (decentralized training adding one dataset at a time); 3) model adaptation (reference model trained on 12 healthy-only datasets, adapted to 4 clinical datasets); 4) anomaly detection using z-scores from adapted model. Healthy-only datasets for reference model: ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI, FCON, HCP, HCPAG, HCPDV, IXI, NKI, OPN, PNC, UKBB. Clinical datasets for adaptation: CNP, HCPEP, OASIS3, TOP.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "In each experimental run, 80% of healthy samples are randomly selected to train the regression model. The remaining 20% are used for the evaluation." ... "we first use a linear homoscedastic model to estimate the parameters of the reference normative model on datasets with only healthy participants (ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI, FCON, HCP, HCPAG, HCPDV, IXI, NKI OPN, PNC, and UKBB). Then, in each run 50% of random healthy participants in clinical datasets, including CNP, HCPEP, OASIS3, and TOP are used to recalibrate the parameters of the reference model."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Single normative model estimated using HBR. Total scans=37126, Total patients=1107 (49 SZ + 49 BD + 41 ADHD from CNP; 25 ADHD from FCON; 123 EP from HCPEP; 271 DM + 51 MCI from OASIS3; 167 SZ + 193 BD + 31 MDD + 107 others from TOP). Healthy controls = 37126 - 1107 = 36019. In multi-site regression experiments, 80% used for training (approximately 28815 HC), 20% for testing (approximately 7204 HC). Note: In model adaptation experiment, reference model trained on 12 healthy-only datasets only.
